description: unreachable::a_quiet_helper_asks_for_the_person_while_its_maker_cannot_be_reached timed out on 2026-11-08 in a full gate on main (3f1e0b63) at load 21.7, waiting for the helper to go quiet again once its maker answers (asking still held laptop/p2). Alone it passed twice, but in 11 s each time: over half its 20 s budget on an idle machine, so either the wait it measures is slow on purpose and the budget is tight, or the return to quiet waits on a timer. Find which before widening the budget.
title: 🎲 A quiet helper's return to quiet can outlive its 20-second wait under load
